data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were GBP 205.27m. During 2018 the syndicate recorded a gross prior-year strengthening of GBP 6.76m (3.29% of opening reserves). Net prior-year development was reported favourably at GBP 3.94m after reinsurance. The movement reflects a mixture of favourable releases in Property-related classes and adverse development in Marine and Third Party Liability; current year catastrophe events (notably Californian wildfires and Hurricane Michael) were material drivers of claims activity in 2018, while earlier 2017 Atlantic hurricane losses (Harvey, Irma, Maria) reduced slightly during the year.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, prior year column). Prior year development gross figure taken from Technical Provisions note 'Change in prior year provisions' (gross = GBP 6,760k). Many line-by-line prior year movements provided in the claims note are presented as net of reinsurance (these have been used for LOB-level directions but are NET amounts and therefore do not sum to the gross prior year movement). Some named event impacts are mentioned qualitatively or as net movements (e.g. Hurricanes Harvey/Irma/Maria reduced by GBP 0.9m) and are not quantified on a gross basis in the report; where only net figures were available these were not used as the primary gross prior-year movement.
